Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: MAP items from today's discovery call

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo and walkthrough today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can keep toward the Jan timeline: 

- Procurement will need our vendor onboarding packet (Ariba/Coupa setup info + vendor form).
- They require a completed W-9 and banking details for ACH setup.
- Legal asked to confirm standard Govt/HealthCare redlines are supported (data processing, audit logs).

Can you send a draft MAP with milestones and owners for vendor onboarding so I can share with procurement?

Sally
Sally Jones
Director, Procurement
Acme Health

Hi Sally (and procurement team),

Thanks — attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the vendor onboarding milestone. High-level summary below and next steps. Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx and a copy of our completed W-9 (W-9_Redwood.pdf).

MAP milestone: Vendor onboarding / procurement setup
- Target close date: 2027-01-15 (aligned to your Q1 rollout)
- Dependencies: Ariba/Coupa vendor creation, completed Acme vendor form, signed SOW/PO, ACH banking details + W-9
- Owners: Acme Procurement (vendor form & Ariba/Coupa entry), Acme Finance (banking setup/ACH), Redwood (provide W-9, vendor profile, onboarding packet), Redwood Legal (address any contract redlines)
- Milestones & proposed dates:
  1) MAP & procurement checklist shared — 2026-12-03 (done)
  2) Acme vendor form returned — 2026-12-10
  3) Ariba/Coupa vendor entry completed — 2026-12-17
  4) Finance banking verification / ACH setup — 2026-12-20
  5) Final SOW/PO issued & signed — 2026-12-30
  6) Production onboarding / first run — 2027-01-15

Next steps:
- Sally/procurement: please confirm the vendor form contact and whether you need the Redwood profile in Ariba (we can provide the XML or account details).
- Camila: I'll need help coordinating the onboarding packet and contract follow-up (cc'd).
- Rafael: can you pick up any procurement-facing questions around banking or the vendor portal for this account?

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), W-9_Redwood.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — good first pass. A few quick additions from the CS/Onboarding side: 

- I'll own the onboarding packet (runbook, connection checklist, test plan). I'll aim to have the packet ready by 2026-12-14 so you have time to validate before Ariba/Coupa entry.
- Rafael, can you confirm whether Redwood needs to be added as a supplier in Ariba or if Acme prefers Redwood to submit the vendor form directly? Also flag any required tax IDs or banking file format for ACH (we typically provide bank routing + account number in a secured form).
- Two minor timeline asks from ops: if Ariba entry slips beyond 12/17, suggest pushing final PO date to 2027-01-07 to preserve a comfortable test window.

I'll attach a supplier profile template we use internally — happy to pre-fill if procurement wants it.

Camila Reyes
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com

From: Sally Jones <sally.jones@acmehealth.com>

Marissa / team — this looks great, thanks. A few notes from procurement: 

- Our vendor onboarding contact is Tom Lee (cc'd). Please send the completed vendor form and your supplier profile template to procurement@acmehealth.com and Tom directly.
- We use Coupa. Tom will confirm whether he needs a supplier XML or if the web form is sufficient.
- We can accept a PDF copy of the W-9 for the file. For banking details, we require a bank letter or voided check in addition to the ACH form (internal policy).

Tom: can you confirm Coupa flow and send any specific file templates?

Sally
Sally Jones
Director, Procurement
Acme Health
